title: secp256r1 (P-256) P256VERIFY Precompile
description: Adds a P256VERIFY precompile at Ethereum address (i.e., 0x0100) to the FEVM, enabling efficient verification of secp256r1 (P-256) elliptic curve signatures.

storageProviders: Enables use of modern, efficient signature schemes for sector commitments
clients: Provides compatibility with ECDSA P-256 signatures used in enterprise and government systems
tokenHolders: No direct impact on FIL token economics
applicationDevelopers: Allows FEVM contracts to verify P-256 signatures directly without external libraries
Reduces gas costs for signature verification using standardized curves
